affordability.notes: Estimated transition cost is roughly $1,100–$1,300 per month. After applying approximately $30,000–$40,000 from the current-home sale, the stabilized estimate is roughly $850–$1,000 per month. Actual loan terms, taxes, insurance, and cash to close remain unverified.

qualification.exceptionReason: The likely transition payment exceeds the retirement target and no seller-financing or overlap solution is advertised; the existing 50-amp RV hookup, complete utilities, no advertised restrictions, low modeled flood risk, and exceptional workshop make it a strong Maybe.
